_INSTRUCTIONS.note: Watch & Memorize - students see words one by one, then must pick them from a list
_INSTRUCTIONS.format: Simple array of words - the game will randomly select which to show and which are distractors
_INSTRUCTIONS.minimum: Include at least 30 words for good variety across 5 rounds
_INSTRUCTIONS.tip: Mix categories or keep themed - both work well!
_INSTRUCTIONS.difficulty: Easy: 4 words from 8, Medium: 6 from 12, Hard: 8 from 16
